findings.reason: The original standalone tile has the transport and two-case mild formulas but no picture. A time-age characteristic schematic materially clarifies why tracing backward reaches either t=0 or a=0 and why the two formulas switch at a=t. This is warranted explanatory diagram intake, not an assertion that the existing definition was mathematically incomplete.
findings.action: Added a final Remarks explanation and TikZ characteristic schematic with initial-cohort and birth-inflow rays, survival factors, the a=t separator, and unbounded age axis.

correction: Appended an explanatory characteristic-flow diagram in Remarks; retained all original definition text and equations byte-for-byte. No frontmatter was edited.

diagram_math_checks.objects: The quadrant has horizontal time and vertical age; the dotted vertical marks a fixed observation time 0<t<=T. The age-axis arrow continues upward, and there is no upper-age boundary.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The Definition gives a>=0 without a finite cutoff and time 0<t<=T (lines 35-37,55).

diagram_math_checks.relation: The initial ray runs from (0,a0) to (t,a0+t) with a0>0 and survival S(a0,t). Its coordinate increments are equal: (0,1.3) to (4,5.3).
diagram_math_checks.justification: The characteristic law a(r)=a(0)+r (line 43) and survival definition (line 45) give this path. Substitution a=a0+t into the a>=t branch (line 53) gives n0(a0)S(a0,t).

diagram_math_checks.relation: The birth ray runs from (s,0), 0<s<t, to (t,t-s), marked with S(0,t-s). Coordinate increments are equal: (1.5,0) to (4,2.5).
diagram_math_checks.justification: Starting the characteristic at boundary time s gives age t-s. Substitution into the a<t branch (line 53) gives B(s)S(0,t-s), matching n(s,0)=B(s) from line 41.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The dashed ray from the corner satisfies a=t. The initial ray lies above it and the birth ray below it; both solid arrows point toward increasing time and age.
diagram_math_checks.justification: Their age-minus-time constants are respectively a0>0 and -s<0, directly separating the inequalities in line 53. No commutativity, feedback arrow, finite-age absorption, or extra model relation is asserted.

diagram_math_checks.relation: The original definition and all formulas remain independent of the diagram.
diagram_math_checks.justification: The entire pre-edit carrier is an exact byte prefix of the edited carrier; the added explanatory Remarks supplies no hypothesis or logical dependency.
